_doc: Declarative API contracts for the smoke test.
Each entry under `checks` describes ONE request and what shape the
frontend expects in return. The smoke runner reads this file, makes
2. Every key in `expect_keys` is present at the response root
every key in `expect_item_keys` is present on each item under
Why this exists: 5 of the last ~12 bug-fixes were field-name
mismatches across the FE/BE boundary (priceFormatted missing from
/orders; full_name vs fullName; etc.). A flat JSON contract file
is the cheapest way to catch those before the user does.
To add an endpoint: drop a new object into `checks`. No code change

checks.name: GET /api/health/full
checks._note: Used by Support → System Health tab. Returns ok/warn/fail per subsystem (database, twilio, migrations, catalog, stations).

checks.name: GET /api/orders/pending
checks._note: Backend now sends both camelCase and snake_case for all of these (was just snake-case for order_number).

checks.name: GET /api/users
checks._note: UserManagementTab reads user.fullName (camelCase) but backend currently returns full_name. Latent mismatch — see ROADMAP_HARDENING.md.

checks.name: GET /api/inventory (station 1)
checks._note: Response shape varies by station; just checking 200 is enough to confirm route is up.

checks.name: GET /api/diagnostics/database (Emergency tab)
checks._note: Recent bug: support_role_required rejected demo tokens. Smoke catches that regressing.

checks.name: GET /api/pricing-settings
checks._note: vip_free is the comp-VIP toggle. Missing it = regression of the VIP-free feature.

checks.name: GET /api/catalog/milk
checks._note: Catalog is the source of truth for option lists. Missing keys here = regression of the catalog feature; every UI reads from it.

checks.name: GET /api/walkin-defaults
checks._note: Walk-in dialog reads from this to seed initial values. Missing fields = regression of the per-event walk-in defaults feature.

checks.name: POST /api/catalog/milk (write path)
checks._note: Idempotent: item_id is derived from name, so re-running the smoke is safe (no duplicate rows). Catches breakage in the InventoryManagement 'Add custom milk' flow + the Quick Setup 'apply custom blend' flow, both of which hit this endpoint.

checks.name: GET /api/client-errors (recent crashes)
checks._note: Surfaces React Error Boundary catches from real iPads. Missing = the crash visibility feature regressed; ClientCrashesPanel in Support → Diagnose will silently show 'no crashes' when in fact the endpoint is broken.

checks.name: GET /api/readiness
checks._note: Operator-facing readiness aggregator. Drives the Organiser → Readiness page; missing = a regression of the demo-readiness gate (Steve will find out only when an event fails).

checks.name: GET /api/event-templates
checks._note: Saved Quick Setup presets. Empty list is fine — we just need the shape. Catches regressions in the template feature that would otherwise only show up as a broken Templates dropdown in Quick Setup.

checks.name: GET /api/client-events (structured event log)
checks._note: Sibling of /client-errors — non-crash signals (feature usage, recoverable failures). Backend sink for services/logging.js. Empty events list is fine; we just need the shape.

checks.name: POST /api/quick-setup/dry-run
checks._note: Drift-preview endpoint. Quick Setup modal calls this before the destructive apply. Missing = regression of the preview-before-wipe safety net.

checks.name: POST /sms/clicksend (inbound webhook)
checks._note: Provider-aware inbound route. NOTE the path has NO /api prefix — the sms_routes blueprint mounts at root, same as the Twilio webhook at /sms (Flask serves all paths directly; Railway runs run_server.py with no /api-stripping proxy). 503 is fine here — a TESTING_MODE deploy may not have a coffee_system wired for SMS. 200/204 means the provider parsed + the route handed off cleanly.

checks.name: POST /sms/cellcast (inbound webhook)
checks._note: Same idea as the ClickSend smoke — confirms the route + parser exist. Path has NO /api prefix (see ClickSend note above).

checks.name: POST /api/users/ (account create write path)
checks._note: Idempotent across runs: 201 on first run, 400 ('Username already exists') on every subsequent run. Both pass — what we're really checking is that the route still routes, accepts the field shape (username/password/email/full_name/role), and doesn't 500 / 308 / 401 / 422. The Quick Setup event-accounts flow and Organiser User Management both POST here; recent regressions in this path (308-on-trailing-slash, fullName vs full_name camelcase) would have been caught here.

checks.name: POST /api/orders (walk-in write path)

body.notes: smoke test order — safe to delete

checks._note: The Readiness 'Send test order' button and every walk-in submit hit this. Returns vary in shape (success+order_number or order_id), so we only assert status — not keys. A non-200 here means the walk-in pipeline is broken at the door.

checks.name: GET /api/orders/NOPE/receipt (customer receipt route)
checks._note: Customer-facing branded receipt (browser → Save-as-PDF), linked from the 'order ready' SMS when PUBLIC_BASE_URL is set. Public (no JWT) since customers open it from a phone. We assert a clean 404 for a non-existent order number — that confirms the route is wired and the not-found branch works without needing to mint a real order in the smoke. A 405/500 here would mean the route regressed.
